capture_geometry.value: Close immersive environmental view with no visible horizon; layered foliage scale, overlap and blur create depth rather than architectural perspective.
capture_geometry.uncertainty_note: Exact camera elevation, focal length, body and distance remain unknown.

capture_geometry.value: A strongly soft lower-left near mass, clearer central/right foliage and dark receding background establish at least three occluded depth stages.
capture_geometry.source_region: lower-left foreground, central/right foliage, dark upper background

capture_geometry.value: Vegetation fills and exits every edge; asymmetric branch masses frame a darker central corridor and the dominant photographic mass is not a centered object portrait.

focus_optics.value: Strong foreground softness, clearer middle foliage and moderate background softness produce a natural near-to-mid-to-far sharpness gradient.
focus_optics.uncertainty_note: Aperture and optical design remain unknown.

lighting.value: Broad low-specularity environmental illumination produces dispersed foliage highlights without a hard cast-shadow system; photographic highlights remain below the light typography in authority.
Canopy-filtered ambient illumination may explain the soft regional variation and restrained highlights.
lighting.uncertainty_note: Natural versus artificially augmented illumination is not proven.

exposure_tonality.value: Deep green-black fields dominate, middle greens retain foliage readability and scarce photographic highlights protect the information hierarchy through regional rather than global contrast control.
exposure_tonality.source_region: full frame, especially top and lower footer field

color_grade.value: Cool-to-neutral deep environmental hues dominate, a warmer near field remains secondary, and photographic saturation is bounded so graphic light and optional accent roles can lead; green itself is not an invariant.

texture_sharpness.value: Irregular needles, overlapping stems, natural edge variation and selective rather than global sharpness preserve photographic material credibility.
texture_sharpness.source_region: right evergreen branch, central foliage, lower-left foreground

subject_styling.value: The environment is an identity-bearing spatial field with layered occlusion, an active middle plane and information-support pockets, not generic scenic wallpaper.

post_processing.value: Likely restrained environmental highlight suppression and local tonal shaping protect information zones while retaining natural texture; no synthetic bloom or aggressive global sharpening is evidenced.
post_processing.uncertainty_note: Exact retouch operations, software and workflow remain unknown.

semantic_intent.value: A named food/restaurant identity is framed as an authored environmental world: the display name becomes a landscape-like object while subordinate claim, voice and ownership roles build secondary readings.

attention_hierarchy.value: First read is the broad light authored display object; second read is sparse claim/support information; third read is expressive and ownership closure, separated by scale, contrast and vertical register.

grid_geometry.value: Peripheral top cadence, a broad optically balanced asymmetric central identity cluster, a separated lower expressive band and footer closure share the canvas without mechanical centering.
grid_geometry.source_region: top, central title field and footer

typography_lettering.value: A short display name behaves as one irregular authored object through unequal glyph mass, deliberate counter cuts, controlled missing-stroke geometry and bounded erosion; exact source contours are excluded.
typography_lettering.uncertainty_note: Font ancestry and construction workflow remain unknown; the mechanism is unvalidated for new copy.

copy_meaning.value: Literal identity, support claims, expressive voice and ownership copy have distinct semantic and authority roles; wording may change only truthfully and must not become decorative filler.

whitespace_density.value: Dark lower-frequency pockets act as active negative space inside the photograph, while dense and quiet registers alternate vertically instead of filling every region equally.

color_system.value: Light display and claim information own maximum contrast, quieter support bridges the hierarchy, an optional limited accent may connect semantic roles, and the photograph remains the dominant chromatic field; exact colors are freedoms.

graphic_language.value: Supporting marks are admissible only when derived from the new subject, process or identity and when they perform a hierarchy/counterweight role; source mountain, badge, path and scribble tokens are not reusable surface devices.

layer_crop_edge.value: The photographic field bleeds through all edges while inset graphic information interacts with local texture and depth without dividing the photograph into generic rectangular modules.
layer_crop_edge.source_region: full frame and central title cluster

material_print.value: Controlled erosion belongs only to the display surface and is not proof of a specific print process; functional type remains comparatively clean and global faux-rustic distress is excluded.

sequence_system.value: No campaign sequence is validated. A future family member may vary layout, crop, density and copy only under the recorded hypothesis and operator tests.

photo_type_dominance.value: A broad high-authority title mass counterbalances an edge-to-edge active environmental photograph; neither the identity object nor the photographic world is allowed to erase the other.

shared_color_logic.value: The environment owns chromatic area, light type owns authority, and any accent remains scarce and semantically assigned; the role relation may transfer while the source palette may not.

negative_space_for_type.value: Text size and weight are calibrated to local image luminance and frequency: small information uses quiet pockets while the dominant display object may cross richer texture.
negative_space_for_type.source_region: top claim pockets, central title backing field, bottom footer field

crop_copy_interaction.value: Crop, quiet fields and information registers are co-composed so high photographic detail and high graphic detail are not maximized everywhere simultaneously.

light_hierarchy_interaction.value: Photographic highlights stay below the brightest type and broad dark regions protect subordinate information without global panels or after-the-fact shadows.

semantic_motif_binding.value: Only newly derived subject/process/identity forms may perform motif work; source mountain, seal, badge or path shapes must be omitted or rebound rather than copied.
semantic_motif_binding.uncertainty_note: The specific source path narrative is not proven and the path is optional.

realism_protection.value: Continuous photographic texture, natural edges and selective depth remain visible beneath limited clean graphic intervention; global distress, glow or synthetic repainting fails.

thumbnail_second_read.value: At thumbnail scale the display object remains the first read and the active environment remains the counter-mass; at normal view three authority levels and local photo/type calibration become legible.
thumbnail_second_read.uncertainty_note: Future controlled generation and independent human pixel review are required.

degrees_of_freedom.guardrail: A generic stock backdrop or flat texture is not sufficient.

degrees_of_freedom.allowed_change: Reframe the environment and move major masses while retaining depth staging, an active image field and usable information pockets.
degrees_of_freedom.guardrail: Do not mechanically scale or preserve exact source coordinates.

degrees_of_freedom.allowed_change: Increase or reduce local detail when graphic density and type authority change inversely by region.

degrees_of_freedom.allowed_change: Replace or omit path, badge and supporting devices using structural motifs derived from new subject, process or identity.

operators.break_condition: Generic stock backdrop, flat depth, no local type-safe field or arbitrary reuse of source surface tokens.

operators.instruction: Move crop, title mass, information registers and peripheral counterweights while preserving three authority levels and local photo/type calibration.
operators.break_condition: Mechanical centering, copied source coordinates, duplicated title, lost quiet fields or collapsed hierarchy.

operators.instruction: Recompose rather than scale the depth frame, information registers, title mass and quiet zones for a materially different aspect ratio.
operators.break_condition: Proportional scaling, empty extension, duplicated title, lost peripheral balance or unprotected microcopy.

operators.instruction: Change subject and accent hues while preserving luminance authority, saturation scarcity and role separation between environment, primary type, support and optional accent.
operators.break_condition: Literal green/orange recolor recipe, accent overexpansion, reduced text contrast or implausible environmental color.

operators.instruction: Create a quieter or denser member by changing photographic and graphic density regionally and inversely rather than changing every region together.

operators.instruction: Replace or omit path, badge and semantic devices using forms derived from the new subject/process/identity rather than source tokens.
